description: This Java source file defines the class 'DefinitionManager' which manages a GUI for handling ECU definition files, including adding, removing, reordering, and saving configurations.

classes.name: DefinitionManager
classes.description: A Swing-based GUI frame for managing ECU definition files including their order, addition, removal, and persistence.

methods.name: DefinitionManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GUI, icon, list, and settings.

methods.name: initSettings
methods.description: Loads ECU definition files from SettingsManager and populates the list.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles UI actions such as adding, removing, moving, saving, or cancelling changes.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Serializes the current list of file paths into SettingsManager.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Opens a file chooser dialog to select a new ECU definition file to add.

methods.name: moveSelection
methods.description: Moves the selected file up or down in the list based on direction.

methods.name: removeSelection
methods.description: Removes the selected definition file from the list.

methods.name: updateListModel
methods.description: Refreshes the GUI list display with current file path entries.
